title: Our native garden
text: If you’re here, you’ve probably walked by our house and noticed the garden in our front yard. Maybe you’ve wondered: what are you growing, why are you growing it, and why are you growing it there? We’d love to tell you all about it! So we made this webpage to do just that. And maybe by the end of it, you might even wonder: how can I start a garden like yours in my own yard?
